title: #onthisday some disney adults learned what musicals are 🤣 #lionking #...
transcript: The Lion King a musical? This thread is my new obsession. Kev on stage asks this debate, and I was like, is this a debate? Has this ever been a debate? Apparently I was wrong. It has. It's a debate. If it is a musical, then so is Pocahontas, The Little Mermaid, and whatever other Disney movies we grew up with back in the day. Yes. Not a musical. All Disney animated movies have singing. That does not make it a musical. The Little Mermaid singing crab, frozen singing Elsa, not a musical either. Even if you want to argue that animated films can't be musicals, which is wrong. Um, these all went to Broadway. Little Mermaid, Lion King, Frozen. Broadway. All of them. No, it's an animated Disney movie. Completely different genre. This keeps coming up, the idea that an animated film cannot be a musical, and I don't understand it. Is it because people just hate musicals and they don't wanna say they like a musical or that they've ever liked a musical? I, I don't get it. No, it's a cartoon. Most cartoons have music or songs in them, but we don't recognize them as musicals. This is a Disney animated feature. The fact that it is a cartoon disqualifies it from a musical. So here's the thing. There are cartoons that have music that are not musicals. I would say most Pixar films are not musicals. Toy Story, you got a friend in me, a song, In a cartoon movie, not a musical. If the characters are singing and those songs are furthering the story. Musical. I don't consider it one, but anyone who calls it a musical is kind of right. Yes, cause The Lion King is a musical.
